claims.text: These records show different actors’ acts: Congress declares; the British king acknowledges the named states’ independence, including Massachusetts Bay. Neither record alone tracks wartime control of Boston or New York, or establishes the rights or consent of enslaved people or Indigenous nations. NPS separately reports British control of New York City after the 1776 Brooklyn battle until 1783.
